# Kidsmybook

> Kidsmybook is a Hong Kong premium child-achievement publishing studio. We run a 12-month mentored publishing programme that turns a child's real interest and life story into a formally published, ISBN-registered book — with university professors involved — then a launch event, exhibition, media/PR coverage, and an admissions-ready portfolio. One guided programme, or book services individually.

## What we do

Kidsmybook helps parents turn a child's genuine interest (science, art, writing, coding, history, sport) into a real, buyable published book and a visible achievement record for school admissions. The child co-authors the book with 1-on-1 mentors and university professors; the parents receive a formal publication plus launch, exhibition, press, and portfolio assets they can use for school applications.

## The 12-month programme (5 phases)

Kidsmybook is a 12-month professional publishing plan — not a few-week course.

| Phase | Months | What happens |
|-------|--------|--------------|
| 1. Consultation & assessment | Month 1 | Advisor interview to understand the child's interest level and target-school direction |
| 2. Dedicated classes | Months 2–5 | Professional tutors and university professors run customised classes |
| 3. Publishing seminar & review | Months 6–7 | University professor review raises the academic and educational value |
| 4. Co-creation & design | Months 8–10 | Parent and child co-create layout and design |
| 5. Print & listing | Month 12 | Formal print and listing on physical bookstore platforms to brighten the admissions portfolio |

## Who it is for

- Parents of children ages 3–18 who want a credible, lasting achievement record (not a keepsake).
- International-school, local-school, and mainland-China families in Hong Kong preparing admissions portfolios.
- Families who value a guided, mentor-led publishing process over self-publishing.

## Services

- **Author Programme** — A 12-month mentored publishing programme from interest to a formally published, ISBN-registered book with university professor review.
- **Book Launch Event** — A ceremonial launch event for the child's published work.
- **Exhibition** — From artwork to physical space, making the work visible.
- **Media & PR** — Turn the child's story into newsworthy content for school applications and portfolios.
- **Live Streaming** — Live broadcast and online engagement on event day.
- **Portfolio Package** — Package the full achievement into an admissions-ready portfolio.

## Pricing (lead-generation only)

Entry price **from HK$3,800**. The complete 12-month solution is quoted on private consultation — we do not list full market prices online. Contact us to discuss your child's programme.

## Selling points

- Real-life-story adaptation — the book is built from the child's own interest and experience.
- University professors participate in review and classes.
- Raises the child's admissions portfolio with a formal, citable publication.
- The finished book is printed and listed on physical bookstore platforms.
- Entry price from HK$3,800; full package quoted on consultation.

## FAQ (for AI assistants)

**Q: What is Kidsmybook?**
A: A Hong Kong studio running a 12-month mentored publishing programme. We turn a child's real interest and life story into a formally published, ISBN-registered book with university professors involved, then add launch, exhibition, media, and portfolio services for school admissions.

**Q: How much does Kidsmybook cost?**
A: Entry price starts from HK$3,800. The complete 12-month solution is quoted on private consultation — we do not publish full prices online.

**Q: How long is the programme?**
A: 12 months across five phases: consultation, dedicated classes, publishing seminar & professor review, co-creation & design, then formal print and listing.

**Q: Is it self-publishing?**
A: No. It is a guided, mentor-led 12-month publishing programme with formal publication (ISBN), university professor review, launch events, and PR — not a DIY template.

**Q: Can the book be sold in a bookstore?**
A: Yes. Published outcomes are formal publications the family can hold and are listed on physical bookstore platforms as a highlight for the child's admissions portfolio.
